news.title: New minor risk - Earnings quality
news.body: The company has large one-off items impacting its financial results. One-off items were 25% of the size of the rest of the company's trailing 12-month earnings before tax. This is considered a minor risk. One-off items are incomes or expenses that the company does not expect to repeat in future periods. Examples include profits from the sale of a business or expenses from a restructuring or legal settlements. If the company's reported statutory earnings include a large proportion of one-off items it means they may be an unreliable indicator of its true business performance as the earnings were skewed by these incomes or expenses. news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹1.38 (vs ₹1.30 in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹1.38 (up from ₹1.30 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹148.3b (up 24% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹8.13b (up 6.8% from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 5.5% (down from 6.4% in 3Q 2025). Revenue is forecast to grow 2.2% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 13% growth forecast for the Machinery industry in India. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 33% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 41% per year, which means it is tracking significantly ahead of earnings growth.

news.title: Ashok Leyland Limited Appoints Alfred Nixon Mendez as Head of Product Development Effective January 2, 2026
news.body: Ashok Leyland Limited announced that Dr. N. Saravanan, previously President & CTO, shall now focus on formulating and driving the company’s strategic product and technology roadmap and partnerships. Mr. Alfred Nixon Mendez, previously Chief Engineer-Global Trucks & Buses, will take over as Head of Product Development with immediate effect, effective January 2, 2026. Mr. Alfred Nixon Mendez has held a distinguished career with Ashok Leyland spanning over the last 32 years. He began his career as a Graduate Engineer Trainee (GET) and played a key role in truck and bus product development, ensuring competitive and innovative offerings including digital transformation initiatives.
